declared_deviations: D5: rubric prompt has 4 documented typo/whitespace normalisations (acton->act on, content,which->content, which, others,  engage->others, engage, deviation.It->deviation. It)
D6/D7: minor apostrophe / trailing-whitespace differences in 3 prompt constants
D-E1: malformed evaluator JSON falls back to score 1 (parse failures counted per run)
D-LLM1: local HF generation uses top_p=1.0 (paper OpenAI path had no top_p; author local path used 0.9)
D-LLM2: no provider-level local retry; transient failures become explicit failed runs
D10: author-absent regeneration helper in OppositeDay/Acronym is dead on Phase 14 path
D11: runner_debug.py holds stale pre-fix loop and is not imported
LOCAL_MODEL_SUBSTITUTION: gpt-4o attacker/target/evaluator -> local Qwen3-4B / Phi-4-mini
LOCAL_RUNTIME_ADAPTATION: constrained JSON decoding (JSONGrammarLogitsProcessor) to reproduce GPT-4o structured-output contract
scope_claims: This is a local substitute-model reproduction.
The experiment does NOT claim to reproduce the paper's absolute GPT-4o ASR.
The primary interpretable comparison is NBF-OFF versus NBF-ON under the frozen local model configuration.
structured_output_notes: Constrained JSON decoding is used to reproduce the structured-output contract required by the original attacker interface. Prompts and attack logic remain unchanged. The JSONGrammarLogitsProcessor constrains token generation to produce valid JSON at each step. This is a local runtime adaptation, not an algorithmic change.
